description: Fetch an account's followers, about 70 a page, or with `type=following` the accounts it follows: each an account, with its counts and bio. Use this to see who an audience is. Give exactly one of `username` or `url`. Costs 13 credits, cached or not; a failed call is refunded.

cursor.description: The `meta.next_cursor` from the previous page. Omit for the first page.

fresh.description: Skip the cache and fetch now. Charged normally. Not available on trial credits — buy any pack to unlock it.

type.description: Who follows the account, or whom it follows.

username.description: The username. A leading @ is fine.

name: get_x_followers
title: Get an X account's followers or following
